# CBOR-Web — The Binary Protocol for AI Agents

> Open protocol (RFC 8949) that makes websites machine-readable. 100× cheaper, 95% signal ratio, cryptographic identity built in. 8 SDKs, 38 sites live.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/README.md) — Project overview, architecture, comparison table, quick start
- [CBOR-WEB-CORE.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-CORE.md) — Full specification: manifest, pages, content blocks, access control
- [CBOR-WEB-SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-SECURITY.md) — DoS protection, CORS, rate limiting, production checklist
- [CBOR-WEB-REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-REFERENCE.md) — Reference data, constants, enumerations
- [CBOR-WEB-MULTIMEDIA.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-MULTIMEDIA.md) — Images, audio, video handling in CBOR blocks
- [CBOR-WEB-GENERATIVE.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-GENERATIVE.md) — AI-specific fields, prompts, model hints
- [CBOR-WEB-ECONOMICS.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CBOR-WEB-ECONOMICS.md) — Token economics, billing model, pricing
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) — How to contribute: PR guidelines, issue templates
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/SECURITY.md) — Vulnerability reporting, security policy

## Deploy

- [Deploy (site)](https://www.cborweb.com/#deploy) — 2-command deployment: text2cbor + cbor-server
- [text2cbor README](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/tools/README.md) — HTML-to-CBOR converter (Rust CLI)
- [cbor-server README](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/tools/README.md) — Static CBOR file server with well-known endpoint
- [IETF Internet-Draft](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/spec/draft-plot-cbor-web-00.md) — draft-plot-cbor-web-00.md specification

## API

- [API page (site)](https://www.cborweb.com/#api) — Account creation, API key, upload endpoint, CBORW token
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deltopide_edy/cborweb) — @deltopide_edy/cborweb (TypeScript/JavaScript SDK)
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/npm-package/README.md) — npm install, manifest(), page(), bundle()
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/python/README.md) — pip install cborweb, CBORWebClient
- [Go SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/go/cborweb.go) — go get, CBORWebClient struct
- [PHP SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/php/CborWeb.php) — Composer require, CborWebClient class
- [Ruby SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/ruby/cborweb.rb) — gem install, CBORWebClient module
- [Java SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/java/CborWebClient.java) — Maven/Gradle, CborWebClient class
- [C++ SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/cpp/cborweb.hpp) — Header-only, cborweb::Client
- [React SDK](https://github.com/ploteddie-bit/cbor-web/blob/main/clients/react/) — useCBORWeb hook, CBORWebProvider
